English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #falsenews#hariniamarasuriya#NPP Did Harini Amarasuriya criticize Anura ? False Fact seeker observed a post shared on social media regarding a criticism made by National People’s Power Member of Parliament Harini Amarasuriya to its leader Anura Kumara Dissanayake. by Anonymous | December 20, 2023 “The leader does not know a word of English. He is not fit for presidential candidacy, let alone the leadership of the party,” Harini Amarasuriya stated in a post on social media. Fact Seeker checked Harini Amarasuriya’s social media pages and the internet and found that no such statement was made by Harini Amarasuriya. Later, when Fact seeker asked MP Harini Amarasuriya in this regard, she said that this was a fake post and that she had never made such a statement. Accordingly, Fact Seeker confirms that this post is fake. Latest updates #misleading Did Sri Lankan MPs Receive a Rs. 60,000 Salary Increase?
